youtube.baslik: Does every child understand better when background talk comes from the side? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In the Listening in Spatialized Noise-Sentences test (LiSN-S), the child repeats target sentences from the front while two people tell stories continuously; the improvement in threshold when the stories come from the sides gives the spatial advantage. A child whose talker advantage is normal but whose spatial advantage stays low may not be making enough use of the direction difference; this pattern is considered typical of spatial processing disorder, and the audiogram is often normal.
